source.title: March H2IQ Hour: Hydrogen Fuel Dispensing for Medium- and Heavy-Duty Vehicles
source.publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Hydrogen and Fuel Cell Technologies Office / NREL
source.retrieval: public PDF text and figure captions inspected; no downloadable row-level logger archive found

reported_experiment.facility: NREL Heavy-Duty Hydrogen Fast-Flow Research Facility
reported_experiment.protocol: SAE J2601-5 MCF-HF-G H70 FM300 T40
reported_experiment.tank_configuration: 9 tanks: 7 Type IV and 2 Type III

finding: The public NREL/DOE artifact reports a real heavy-duty fast-fill experiment with station, dispenser and vehicle-side pressure/temperature channels shown in plots, but it does not publish synchronized row-level logger files, controller-state metadata or an explicit raw-data reuse licence.
use: High-value operating-range and protocol face-validity citation, and a data-request lead. Digitized plot points must not be presented as an untouched full-loop holdout.
requested_package: original synchronized station, hose, receptacle and vehicle logger rows
mass-flow and cumulative-mass channels with units
tank geometry, sensor locations and calibration/uncertainty
bank-switching, valve, precooler, stop and fault states
SAE J2601-5 table/MCF inputs and controller configuration
written permission for derived metrics and journal publication
claim_boundary: This public report supports real-test context only. It does not establish digital-twin accuracy or safety-distance validity without the raw synchronized package and a pre-outcome frozen holdout protocol.
